title: P21: IdentifierUri is opaque in mimi-protocol
description: protocol-06 §5.2 defines IdentifierUri as opaque uri<V>, while other sections require a 'valid URI' (e.g. sendingUri, ~L1544). Readings: (a) validate URI syntax at decode; (b) keep the type opaque and validate where a section says the value must be a valid URI. Chosen: (b). Rationale: mirrors the wire definition exactly; zero-length roomId must decode (decision mimid-1wgh.5.27) and is not a URI.
close_reason: Recorded during mimid-1wgh.5.1; reading chosen as described
